WITH mg_payments AS (
  SELECT
    p.payment_type,
    CASE
      WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-03-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-04-01' THEN 'window'
      WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-02-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-03-01' THEN 'baseline'
    END AS period
  FROM payments.order_payments p
  JOIN orders.orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id
  JOIN orders.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  WHERE c.customer_state = 'MG'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-02-01'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-04-01'
),
counts AS (
  SELECT
    payment_type,
    period,
    COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM mg_payments
  GROUP BY payment_type, period
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT
    payment_type,
    MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'window' THEN n END) AS window_n,
    MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'baseline' THEN n END) AS baseline_n
  FROM counts
  GROUP BY payment_type
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(window_n) AS total_window,
    SUM(baseline_n) AS total_baseline
  FROM pivoted
)
SELECT
  p.payment_type,
  p.window_n,
  p.baseline_n,
  ROUND(CAST(p.window_n AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(t.total_window, 0), 4) AS window_share,
  ROUND(CAST(p.baseline_n AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(t.total_baseline, 0), 4) AS baseline_share,
  ROUND(CAST(p.window_n AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(t.total_window, 0) - CAST(p.baseline_n AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(t.total_baseline, 0), 4) AS share_point_change
FROM pivoted p, totals t
ORDER BY p.payment_type;
